[PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
## Consolidated Experience from Similar Tasks
For object placement tasks, use a verify-before-act loop. First identify the object to move and the target surface. Locate the object with find; if the named instance is unavailable, explore alternate instances or locations instead of stopping. Before moving toward a target, check whether the intended path is clear, because obstacles can cause Move failures. If movement is blocked, reroute or adjust the plan rather than assuming forward motion will work. However, do not conclude that an object is out of reach just because movement is obstructed: verify actual proximity before predicting pickup failure. Before Pick, ensure the hand is empty; if it already holds an object, place or drop it first. When find fails, do not assume the target is present or visible; explore alternate locations and confirm availability. Successful placement generally requires successful find and pick_up of the object, successful find of the target surface, and a final successful put_down.

## Preliminary Thinking
1. Parse the task to identify the object to place and the target surface. 2. Check the hand state; if it is not empty, place or drop the held object before attempting a new pickup. 3. Locate the object using find. If it fails, search alternate locations/instances or retry until the object is found or confirmed unavailable. 4. Plan navigation to the object: inspect for obstacles along the path. If blocked, choose a clear route or adjust movement instead of assuming forward movement will succeed. 5. When near the object, attempt pick_up if it appears within reach; do not assume failure solely because movement was obstructed. 6. Locate the target surface using find. If the named instance is unavailable, explore other valid instances or retry. 7. Navigate to the target surface using a clear path; reroute if obstacles appear. 8. Execute put_down to place the object on the target. 9. Verify success by confirming the object was found/picked up, the target surface was found, and put_down succeeded.
[/PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
